title: Unibet takes its betting sites offline after a cyberattack, according to its own statement
date_note: Date of GamblingNews' report (20 Nov); the article gives no time for the shutdown.
place: Not stated (Unibet sites in several countries, including Sweden and the UK per AffPapa)
geo_basis: the source names no country or city; region pin, not a location of the attack
summary: GamblingNews and AffPapa report that Unibet said on X it had temporarily taken Unibet offline as a safety precaution following a cyberattack, and is working to restore access safely. AffPapa says sites in several countries, including Sweden and the UK, are affected and visitors see a maintenance message. Neither article gives details of the attack or a restoration time.
plain: Unibet says a cyberattack led it to take its betting site offline as a precaution. It is working to restore access; AffPapa says Sweden and the UK are among the countries affected.
exec: A gambling operator's sites in several countries, including Sweden and the UK according to AffPapa, are offline after a cyberattack, with no restoration time given.
action: Customers: wait for Unibet's own updates, which it says it will share as soon as it can.

validation.note: Verify desk read GamblingNews (20 Nov), which quotes Unibet's own X announcement ("Following a cyberattack, we've temporarily taken Unibet offline as a safety precaution"); the X post itself and a second publisher could not be read (SBC News and Yogonet return 403; iGaming Business search found nothing). Countries are not named by the article. Single source. Update 23 Nov: AffPapa (read) also quotes Unibet's X statement and names Sweden and the UK; it relays the same statement, so still treated as single source.

review.note: GamblingNews now read: it quotes Unibet's own X statement (cyberattack, taken offline as precaution), multiple countries, maintenance page, no details. Title, summary, date and confirmed status match. Action advised ignoring unsolicited messages, which the source does not say; now points to Unibet's
